claim_tests.claim: Tether has frozen the balances on all 131 TRON addresses.
claim_tests.reason: Checks blacklist membership by end of report day ET. Empty blacklisted addresses still count; this does not freeze native TRX.

claim_tests.claim: the freezing of $26 million in cryptoassets
claim_tests.reason: The March 2025 takedown cluster and all asset contracts are not disclosed by this claim; OFAC's exact identifiers are a narrower cohort. A first blacklist can predate the takedown.

claim_tests.claim: Centre, the consortium behind USDC, followed the U.S. Treasury sanctions against Tornado Cash and blocked the related addresses.
claim_tests.reason: This tests contract blacklisting, not Circle Account access; the issuer page supplies no frozen-dollar target. Later-added identifiers are not assigned an earlier OFAC date.

claim_tests.claim: including freezing wallets previously added to the SDN List.
claim_tests.reason: A retrospective freeze batch is observable. On-chain timing does not establish motive; decision December 1 and announcement December 9 are distinct.

claim_tests.claim: freezing $344 million USD₮ across two addresses.
claim_tests.reason: Native USDT balances at each first freeze, not burn amounts or assumed USD parity. Missing, nonreconciling or tied histories prevent full replication.
claim_tests.vendor_unit: USD₮ approximately; issuer reports as USD million

claim_tests.reason: Native USDT balances at each first freeze, not burn amounts or assumed USD parity. Missing, nonreconciling or tied histories prevent full replication. The vendor's integer total is reproduced (within one USDT) by first-freeze balances PLUS later receipts through its October 7 read cutoff. This is consistent with a later frozen-account balance, rather than the amount present at freezing.

claim_tests.claim: the seven wallets together held 27.94 USDT.
claim_tests.reason: T is start of designation day ET; end-of-day total is also reported. Seven historical blacklist matches include six first freezes on designation day and one empty identifier already blacklisted in January 2025. Thus 'six designation-day freezes' and 'seven ever blacklisted' are compatible; the source's implication that the seventh was never blacklisted is not supported by event history. The 1-USDT balance difference remains unreconciled.
All issuer events, not OFAC-only; cutoff end of 2026-08-12 UTC. Indexer and cutoff conventions remain possible causes of differences.

claim_tests.claim: only 180 appear verbatim on OFAC's published list.
claim_tests.reason: Exact chain-address join, with historical and as-of-active cohorts separate; no vendor labels are treated as listings. A vendor-labelled subset may be smaller.
Vendor benchmark covers the entire issuer burn population; this analysis has only OFAC-address timelines. An empty or small test set cannot confirm a 99% issuer-wide reconstruction rate.
Vendor benchmark covers the entire issuer burn population; this analysis has only OFAC-address timelines. An empty or small test set cannot confirm a 99% issuer-wide reconstruction rate.

claim_tests.claim: 76% of its freezes of listed wallets came inside 7 days of the listing.
claim_tests.reason: The saved table groups freezes since 2024, not identifiers first listed since 2024. Replay counts a new freeze after a removal, but excludes redundant adds while already frozen. Calendar-day lag in ET reproduces same-day/next-seven-day shares and median days. Separately shown first-ever noon-proxy results retain signed hours and publication-time uncertainty; the conventions answer different questions.

claim_tests.vendor_unit: freeze events; median days; percent within seven days

claim_tests.reason: Genuine contract receipts while event-derived blacklist state is active. Includes internal cohort transfers; >=1 USD sensitivity shown separately. Source's 'following days' endpoint is unspecified; our bound is end of October 7 ET.

claim_tests.claim: USDC delays shorter/less dispersed than USDT (qualitative)
claim_tests.reason: Historical ETH identifiers through 2025-03-21; not an exact paper-cohort replication. Our noon-ET proxy is 12 hours later than its midnight proxy. Within-block percentage ranks are a different unit and require block transaction totals, unavailable here.

fetch_status.meaning: provisional describes unfinished acquisition for the stated bounded study; complete describes whole-address history. Terminal privacy/provider gaps and window-only histories stay explicit exceptions. Neither false provisional nor a completed acquisition implies complete population coverage.

findings.confidence: High for event/date ordering; not proof of advance notice, motive or coordination.
findings.detail: Distinct ETH/TRX chain-addresses with lag upper bound <0. Same-day noon-negative lags are excluded. Historical/delisted addresses remain included.
findings.title: Tether blacklist precedes even the earliest possible OFAC publication time

findings.confidence: High for event matching; descriptive policy association, no causal estimate.
findings.detail: Previously listed ETH/TRX identifiers first blacklisted on December 9, 2023 UTC. Long lags reflect retrospective catch-up; pool contracts are separately flagged.
findings.title: Tether's public policy date coincides with a batch of already-listed identifiers

findings.confidence: High for matched event timestamps; this comparison changes cohort composition and is not an adjusted performance estimate.
findings.detail: All 216 valid ever-blacklisted ETH identifiers have median 9,504.058 hours; excluding the 91 historical Tornado identifiers gives 125 matched identifiers and the displayed median. This is why the headline wallet variants exclude Tornado contracts.
findings.title: Tornado Cash changes the Ethereum Tether lag median sharply

findings.confidence: High for event transitions; removals do not by themselves measure spendability of other assets or establish controller identity.
findings.detail: The ledger's March 21, 2025 removal must not be confused with the superseded UID's November 2022 replacement. Examples include full lifecycle events in the CSV; removal transaction links are provided here.
findings.title: Tether removed historical Tornado identifiers after OFAC's March 2025 removal

findings.confidence: High for event transitions; removals do not by themselves measure spendability of other assets or establish controller identity.
findings.detail: The ledger's March 21, 2025 removal must not be confused with the superseded UID's November 2022 replacement. Examples include full lifecycle events in the CSV; removal transaction links are provided here.
findings.title: Circle removed historical Tornado identifiers after OFAC's March 2025 removal

findings.confidence: High for transaction order; unequal holdings and different policy eras limit performance interpretation.
findings.detail: Paired denominator: 216 Ethereum addresses. Same-address issuer timestamps can be compared without knowing intraday OFAC publication time; includes Tornado contracts.
findings.title: Circle blacklisted earlier than Tether on matched Ethereum identifiers

findings.confidence: Provisional token-history subtotal; publication-day bounds are in summaries. Gross volume may recycle funds and includes dust.
findings.detail: 6 chain-addresses with observed outgoing transfers in complete token windows. This is transfer volume, not unique money or evidence of intent.

findings.confidence: Provisional balance reconstruction matches non-atomic latest Tron observations; event-before-day ordering is high confidence. Only two qualifying freeze transactions exist.
findings.detail: Compare with the issuer's April 23 statement and the official April 24 identifier addition. Exact token amounts and event-time USD observations are in the CSV; no assumption of exact USD parity.
findings.title: Two Iran central-bank identifiers held about 344 million USDT when frozen before their OFAC addition

findings.confidence: High for historical blacklist matching; small balances remain conditional on complete Tron transfer histories. A blacklist says nothing about native TRX.
findings.detail: The 'six newly frozen wallets' observation is compatible with seven ever-blacklisted identifiers: one empty identifier was first blacklisted January 28, 2025. Our designation balance subtotal differs by about 1 USDT from PublicAML's 27.94 USDT; no cause is inferred.
findings.title: The seventh Al-Jebouri identifier was already blacklisted before the six July 23 freezes

findings.confidence: Provisional reconstruction of all cohort histories, reconciled to non-atomic latest Tron observations. Arithmetic agreement identifies a compatible timing convention, not the vendor's unpublished calculation.
findings.detail: 536,905.222687 USDT was reconstructed at first freeze across 131 listed Tron identifiers. Adding 1,365.000000 USDT received while blacklisted through October 7 ET gives 538,270.222687 USDT, which rounds to PublicAML's reported 538,270 USDT 'caught' amount. Distinguish value caught at freeze from later deposits into frozen accounts.
findings.title: The ISIS-K reported caught balance includes an amount matching later receipts

findings.confidence: Event-history finding within documented ETH/TRX issuer snapshots; missing holdings histories cannot establish a population-wide zero.
findings.detail: This explicit negative-result search is bounded by genuine-contract holdings observations, not inferred from labels.
findings.title: Observed USDT holders at/after designation with no blacklist event found
